observations.behavior: Adds a separate refresh loop and its own sentinel, while retaining the original tick loop; the refresh loop does not report health and its failure does not restart the pod.
observations.posthog_connection: Warehouse scheduling: the refresh and scheduling are now independent, so a slow refresh does not delay scheduling and a failed refresh does not trip liveness. This could help warehouse scheduling reliability and reduce false restarts.
